question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
-- Full query with all components
WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      WHEN next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END as is_group
  FROM same_station
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNTIF(is_group) as group_trips
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
  g.end_station_id,
  s.name as station_name,
  g.group_trips,
  t.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trips, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_counts g
JOIN total_counts t ON g.end_station_id = t.end_station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON CAST(g.end_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      WHEN next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END as is_group
  FROM same_station
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNTIF(is_group) as group_trips
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
  g.end_station_id,
  s.name as station_name,
  g.group_trips,
  t.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trips, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_counts g
JOIN total_counts t ON g.end_station_id = t.end_station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON CAST(g.end_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
